body: You can probably workaround this if you add `--enable-all-security-services` to the `native-image` call that quarkus makes so that all security algorithms are added. By default this is false, since each Quarkus service adds only what it needs. I've not looked at the Quarkus code in detail, but chances are that the Quarkus/Vert.x integration should add RSA as one of the security algorithms it should make available.
Do you mean by adding "--enable-all-security-services" to docker file image while building or as a run argument to the native file ?
@iabughosh To the image building process, it's parameter of `native-image` which builds native images :)
Btw, the quarkus Maven plugin, for the `native-image` goal, has a parameter called `enableAllSecurityServices` that you should be to enable to achieve the same thing.
@iabughosh it seems similar issues have been filed for other modules, I'm trying to determine if it can be fixed the same way. In the meantime, could you please post a minimal reproducer? Thank you

@iabughosh can you also try to add `SunRsaSign` provider in the app config file:

```properties
quarkus.security.security-providers=SunRsaSign,SunJCE
```

See https://quarkus.io/guides/security#registering-security-providers
Wouldn't producing a `ExtensionSslNativeSupportBuildItem` be enough to solve the issue?
